On The 16 th Of February, 2024
 Misc. Criminal Case No. 4473 of 2024
 Between:-
 Arun Kumar Verma @ Ganesh Mukhiya S/O
 Bihari Mukhiya, Aged About 34 Years,
 Occupation: Labourer, R/O Village Gopalakha
 Bharavsan, District Madhubani (Bihar)
 
 (By Shri Nitin Goyal - Advocate)
 And
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh Through Police
 Station Kampoo, District Gwalior (Madhya
 Pradesh)
 .

(By Shri P. Tanwar - Panel Lawyer)
 This application coming on for admission this day, the 
 following:
 Order

This is first application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. for grant of bail relating to Crime No. 01 of 2024 registered at Police Station Kampoo, District Gwalior (M.P.) for the offence under Sections 420, 120-B of IPC.
Learned counsel for the applicant argued that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated.
As per prosecution story, it was some Arun Kumar who was involved in the crime.
Arun Kumar is the owner of Radha Placement Service who sent co-accused as a domestic help.
The name of present applicant is not Arun Kumar Verma and the cash amount has not been received by him.
The name of present applicant/accused is Ganesh Mukhiya S/o Bihari Mukhiya.
In arrest memo, his name is mentioned as Ganesh Mukhiya S/o Bihari Mukhiya.
The applicant is having Adhar Card bearing No. 5515 3341 2207 on which the name of present applicant is recorded as Ganesh Mukhiya S/o Bihari Mukhiya.

Thus, there is no evidence against the present applicant/accused that he was Arun Kumar Verma @ Ganesh Mukhiya vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 16 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/198901827/
1 involved in the crime as alleged against him.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The applicant is i n custody since 05.01.2024.
The applicant has no criminal antecedents.
He is resident of Faridabad (Haryana) and there is no possibility of his absconding or tempering with prosecution case.
On these grounds, he prays for grant of bail to the applicant.
Per contra, learned counsel for the State has vehemently opposed the bail application and prayed for its rejection.
Heard learned counsel for the rival parties and perused the case diary available on record.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, but without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, this application is allowed and it is directed that the applicant be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.100,000/- (Rupees One Lakh Only) with two solvent sureties [out of which one should be local surety since the applicant is resident of Faridabad (Haryana)] in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court/committal Court.
E- copy of this order be sent to the trial Court concerned for compliance, if possible, by the office of this Court.
Certified copy as per rules.

(SUNITA YADAV) JUDGE vpn Arun Kumar Verma @ Ganesh Mukhiya vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 16 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/198901827/
